documents.memo: Manual accrual posted in NetSuite by AP; reversed on 01 Oct 2026 by JE-NS-88410.

scenario_notes.direct_gl_entry: WLD-B-07: a journal made in NetSuite, USD 250.00 to the subledger-controlled account 2100. It carries no eRev external id, so the subledger-to-GL reconciliation classifies it as a direct GL entry (J-13.11). Only the line on the controlled account is stated; its other side lies on an account the subledger does not control. The documents name no date: 30 Sep 2026 is the last day of the period the entry belongs to.
scenario_notes.trial_balance: The mock computes the closing balances: every journal posted to it through the period end, the documents made in the ERP (POST /__erp/documents) and the documents of this file. A `balances` member ([{account, currency, amount}]) fixes the balances of this workspace, subsidiary and period instead (the demo seed states them, BUILD_SPEC CLO-22).
